_comment: Motion presets for Wan 2.1 i2v. 'name' is the dropdown key. Edit, add or override here. Server hot-reloads on each GET.

presets.name: contemplative_drift
presets.description: Default — slow ethereal drift, ambient mist, divine pulse
presets.motion_prompt: Subtle gentle camera movement, ethereal mist drifting softly, particles floating slowly, divine light pulsing gently, contemplative spiritual atmosphere, no abrupt motion, cinematic Kodak Portra 400 aesthetic

presets.name: sacred_geometry_rotation
presets.description: Mandala/geometry shots — slow concentric rotation, golden light expansion
presets.motion_prompt: Sacred geometry mandala slowly rotating, concentric rings of golden light expanding outward, divine radial bloom, no camera pan, mystical hypnotic atmosphere, smooth rhythmic motion

presets.name: vibration_static
presets.description: Atoms / particles vibrating in place, no camera move, microscopic intensity
presets.motion_prompt: Quantum particles oscillating in place, atoms vibrating with high-frequency tremor, suspended microscopic universe, soft luminous shimmer, no camera movement, intimate energetic stillness

presets.name: matter_dissolve
presets.description: Solid forms dissolving into light/particles, ethereal phase transition
presets.motion_prompt: Solid form dissolving into translucent particles, body silhouette reorganizing into pure light, ethereal phase transition, gentle dispersion, soft emanation, no camera movement

presets.name: color_refraction
presets.description: Light passing through prism — colors shifting through visible spectrum
presets.motion_prompt: Pure white light refracting through crystal prism, rainbow spectrum unfolding, colors slowly shifting from violet to red, fluid wavelength dance, no abrupt motion, cinematic chromatic poetry

presets.name: neural_waves
presets.description: Brain / consciousness shots — pulsing neural waveforms, soft cerebral glow
presets.motion_prompt: Neural waveforms pulsing rhythmically, brainwave patterns oscillating in delta-theta-alpha-beta-gamma sequence, soft cerebral glow, gentle synaptic shimmer, no camera movement, contemplative interior

presets.name: harmonic_convergence
presets.description: Closing / resolution shots — waves aligning, harmonic ripples synchronizing
presets.motion_prompt: Frequency waves aligning into harmonic resonance, ripples converging in synchronization, peaceful resolution, light convergence at center, soft radial bloom, cinematic stillness

presets.name: cosmic_zoom
presets.description: Atmospheric / cosmic shots — slow camera pull-back through stars/space
presets.motion_prompt: Slow camera pulling back through cosmic dust and starlight, vast scale revelation, gentle stellar drift, parallax depth, contemplative cosmic motion, no abrupt cuts
